comments.text: 4:12 You're thinking of Servals being mixed with domestic cats to produce the Savannah hybrid. I had a neighbour who's a breeder. The difference is that humans and dogs are between 80-100 million years apart, and Servals and housecats are about 8-13 million years apart. It's still a tossup how the genes line up, so a lot of F1's don't come to term, and male Savannahs are sterile until around F4, but the point is that servals and housecats are a LOT closer together, to the point that its actually possible to get successful hybrids. If you want human/dog hybrids, you're going to have to do a LOT of genetic engineering.

comments.text:
My mother was on Ambien for her insomnia a while back. She literally would do things that she had no memory of doing. One time she tore apart the bathroom sink to "fix a leak" and did all of that while sleep walking. Another night she drilled a hole in the kitchen counter and we don't know why. Another night she walked out of the house and started down the trail behind the house into the woods in the middle of the night. She also would completely lose time - we took her to the lake to for a hike and BBQ and she didn't remember any of it, we even showed her pictures of us all there. 
Needless to say, after that first few weeks, we had the doctor wean her off and stop it completely. Never again!
